Bug_Details: Use of Joda-Time's DateTime.toDateTime(), Duration.toDuration(), Instant.toInstant(), Interval.toInterval(), and Period.toPeriod() are not allowed. Joda-Time’s DateTime.toDateTime(), Duration.toDuration(), Instant.toInstant(), Interval.toInterval(), and Period.toPeriod() are always unnecessary, since they simply ‘return this’. There is no reason to ever call them.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by using the plus() method to add a duration of 1000 milliseconds to the original duration, instant, and period objects. This creates a new object that is equivalent to the original object plus the added duration.
